semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact four-mana cast, insufficient payment and invented activation reject atomically; the controller's tapped Clock and artifact untap with the active player's artifact, while a nonartifact remains tapped; exact public untap edges and no invented activated offer.
Three nonconsecutive player IDs; controlled artifact creature and noncreature qualify, nonartifact and a third player's artifact remain tapped; real cleanup completes before the untap boundary.
Current ability suppression disables the source; turn-start expiry restores it before determining the untap cohort.
A departed Clock supplies no hook; the same physical card reenters with a fresh generation and supplies its current hook.
A real Sculpting Steel copy retains the hook after donor departure, preserves its own underlying identity, and stops supplying it when its own abilities are removed.

Only logged commands place actual cards, pay Sol Ring's real tap cost and advance the turn; the tapped Ring untaps with unchanged generation, the already upright Clock emits no edge, and every batch and final state replay identically.
